data.prompt: Add a simple counter to a naïve recursive implementation of the grid‑paths problem (without memoisation) and run it for a modest size, e.g. rows=5, cols=5. Then compare the number of times the recursive function is called to the number of cells filled by your DP code. (You can keep the DP code unchanged and just add a global counter to the recursive version.)
data.trace_question: How many times does the naïve recursion evaluate the same sub‑grid (i,j) compared to how many times your DP fills each cell?
data.expected_insight: The naïve recursion calls the function exponentially many times, repeatedly recomputing the same sub‑problems, whereas the DP version computes each sub‑problem exactly once, demonstrating the overlapping‑subproblems property that DP exploits.
